summary: capability-aware scheduler routing — never dispatch to runtimes lacking the capability or in FAILED/DISABLED/RECOVERING
implementation: src/shared/capability-router.ts (pure): ModuleState vocabulary; eligibleCandidates excludes FAILED/DISABLED/RECOVERING and capability-less candidates (reasons recorded), admits DEGRADED (tracked in degraded[])

electron/commander/main-commander.ts dispatchRole: runtime status views → ModuleState mapping (enabled=false ⇒ DISABLED; DOWN ⇒ FAILED; RATE_LIMITED/BUDGET_EXHAUSTED/AUTH_REQUIRED ⇒ DEGRADED) and eligibility filtering before supervisor dispatch
tests: tests/unit/capability-router.test.ts (+3): FAILED/DISABLED blocked with reasons; capability requirement enforced; DEGRADED admitted+tracked
notes: Phase C remains R-301 (standalone-node evidence) before Phase D Fleet.
